select btp.appointment_id as appointmentId,btp.registered_id as registeredId,btp.treatment_id as treatmentId,btp.org_id as orgId,btp.patient_id as patientId, btp.treat_status as treatStatus,btp.treat_type as treatType,btp.appoint_status as appointStatus, btp.appoint_dentist_id as appointDentistId,btp.appoint_start_time as appointStartTime, btp.appoint_duration as appointSuration,btp.appoint_modify_time as appointModifyTime,btp.appoint_content as appointContent,btp.registered_dentist_id as registeredDentistId, btp.registered_time as registeredTime,btp.treat_start_time as treatStartTime,btp.treat_end_time as treatEndTime,btp.assistant_1 as assistant1,btp.assistant_2 as assistant2, btp.assistant_3 as assistant3, bp.name as patientName, bp.gender, appointDentistNameBe.employee_name as appointDentistName, regDentistNameBe.employee_name as regDentistName from base_treatment_process btp left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = btp.patient_id left join base_employee appointDentistNameBe on appointDentistNameBe.user_id = btp.appoint_dentist_id left join base_employee regDentistNameBe on regDentistNameBe.user_id = btp.registered_dentist_id
and #{dentistId} in (btp.appoint_dentist_id,btp.registered_dentist_id)
and btp.org_id = #{orgId}
and date_format(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' ) in (date_format( btp.registered_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ),date_format( btp.appoint_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ))
order by btp.appoint_start_time , btp.registered_date desc

SELECT btp.treatmentId, btp.treatDate, btp.registered_dentist_id AS treatDentistId, be.employee_name AS treatDentistName, btp.org_id AS orgId, bo.abbreviation AS treatOutpatient FROM ( SELECT btp.treatmentId, DATE_FORMAT( btp1.treat_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS treatDate, btp1.registered_dentist_id, btp1.org_id FROM ( SELECT min( btp.treatment_id ) AS treatmentId FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL AND btp.patient_id = #{patientId} ) btp LEFT JOIN base_treatment_process btp1 ON btp.treatmentId = btp1.treatment_id ) btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON btp.org_id = bo.org_id

SELECT btp.treatmentId, btp.treatDate, btp.registered_dentist_id AS treatDentistId, be.employee_name AS treatDentistName, btp.org_id AS orgId, bo.abbreviation AS treatOutpatient FROM ( SELECT btp.treatmentId, DATE_FORMAT( btp1.treat_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS treatDate, btp1.registered_dentist_id, btp1.org_id FROM ( SELECT max( btp.treatment_id ) AS treatmentId FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL AND btp.patient_id = #{patientId} ) btp LEFT JOIN base_treatment_process btp1 ON btp.treatmentId = btp1.treatment_id ) btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON btp.org_id = bo.org_id

SELECT btp.totalReservation, btp1.totalPerformance, btp2.totalMissedAppointment , btp3.numberOfVisits FROM ( SELECT COUNT( btp.appointment_id ) AS totalReservation FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.patient_id = #{patientId} AND btp.appoint_status != 2 ) btp,( SELECT COUNT( btp.appointment_id ) AS totalPerformance FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.patient_id = #{patientId} AND btp.appoint_status != 2 AND btp.registered_id IS NOT NULL ) btp1, ( SELECT COUNT( btp.appointment_id ) AS totalMissedAppointment FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.patient_id = #{patientId} AND btp.appoint_status != 2 AND btp.registered_id IS NULL AND date_format( btp.appoint_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) < date_format( now(), '%Y-%m-%d' ) ) btp2, ( SELECT COUNT( btp.treatment_id ) AS numberOfVisits FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.patient_id = #{patientId} AND btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL ) btp3
